reason: Entirely discretionary news-flow and macro-prediction trading with zero technical rules or concrete entry/exit criteria that can be coded.

universe.description: US equities, indexes, futures, forex, bonds, gold, oil

setup.rule: Identify news or data not yet priced in or diverging from fundamentals
setup.quote: Identify situations where market pricing diverges from the fundamental valuation for a period of time, which can range from seconds to weeks.

entry.rule: Predict event outcome and price reaction ahead of consensus; enter on news release if not already priced
entry.quote: I would actually predict it. So, I would come before it happens and I would decide beforehand if they are going to surprise and be more dovish than expected or not.

stop.rule: Exit immediately if price does not react as predicted after event
stop.quote: if you do get it wrong I just take the loss and wait for the next opportunity.

exits.rule: Exit after event reaction or when consensus forms; hold max ~2 weeks
exits.quote: it goes from seconds, really seconds to a couple days or no more than 2 weeks.

sizing.rule: Increase size on high-conviction unique events; otherwise moderate to meet client volatility limits
sizing.quote: if it's something that's really strong that would definitely incentivize me to to put more size on for sure.

market_filter.rule: Avoid when CTAs or retail momentum dominate; monitor sell-side consensus for discrepancies
market_filter.quote: the CTAs they don't read the news they don't care about the price. They don't care about they don't care about valuation.
